errors.evidence: The AttentionInfluence chart has 15 outer sub-categories (not 16), plus 6 inner main categories, totaling a two-ring structure. The reference confirms 15 outer slices.

These two categories (Science & technology education 19 and Healthy education 2) belong to the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart, not the AttentionInfluence chart. In AttentionInfluence, Science & technology education is labeled '10' and there is no 'Healthy education' category.

Both charts have a two-ring (inner/outer) structure with main categories as inner slices and sub-categories as outer slices. The machine description does not mention this nested/donut ring structure at all.

errors.text_span: colored in shades of blue, green, orange, and purple
errors.evidence: The AttentionInfluence chart uses shades of blue, teal/green, orange, brown/red, and pink/red — not purple. There is no purple in the chart.

errors.text_span: presented in hues of orange, yellow, and green
errors.evidence: The FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart uses similar colors to AttentionInfluence: teal/green, blue, orange, brown, and pink/red — not yellow. The color palette is not accurately described.

errors.text_span: whose proportions range approximately from 1% to 38%
errors.evidence: While Education at 38% is the largest in FineWeb-Edu Classifier, this range description refers only to the outer subcategory values, but 38% is an inner ring value (Education). The machine description conflates inner and outer ring values.

The machine description omits key inner category labels and values for AttentionInfluence (Education 25, Health & Medicine 22, Science 15, History & Society 23, Tech & Engineering 12, Fin & Law 3) and FineWeb-Edu Classifier (Education 38, Health & Medicine 19, Science 15, History & Society 19, Tech & Engineering 8).

errors.text_span: Several slices are visually emphasized through an exploded or offset presentation.
errors.evidence: Neither chart shows any exploded or offset slices. All segments appear as standard pie/donut chart segments.

errors.text_span: Both charts include a legend and percentage labels directly within each slice.
errors.evidence: Neither chart includes a separate legend. The reference explicitly states 'A legend is not included' and 'There is no separate legend.' Labels are placed outside the slices with arrows for smaller segments.
The machine description omits that smaller slices have labels with arrows pointing to them, while larger slices are labeled directly inside.
The largest inner segment in AttentionInfluence is Education at 25%, not 23%. History & Society is 23%.
